[Q3]

A. No true roots

圖中的植物為蘚苔類，具有假根但沒有真根。
The plant in the photo belongs to bryophytes, which have rhizoids but no true roots.
放大的圖片顯示其體型細小，缺乏多種類的細胞或有組織的結構，因此水份運輸僅依賴滲透作用。

蘚苔植物缺乏維管組織，只能依靠假根將植物體固定於基質上。
Bryophytes lack vascular tissues and can only rely on rhizoids to anchor the plant body to substrates.
常見錯誤：誤將蘚苔植物的假根當作能主動吸收水份的真根。

[Q4]
📌 參考答案
D. 細胞種類4
D. Cell type 4
📌 詳細解釋
細胞種類4是木質部，由長而中空的死細胞組成。
Cell type 4 is the xylem, which consists of long and hollow dead cells.
死細胞無法進行代謝分解食物以釋出能量，故答案為D。
Dead cells cannot carry out metabolism to break down food to release energy, so the answer is D.
細胞種類1是皮層，種類2是形成層，種類3是韌皮部，它們皆為活細胞，故選項A、B和C錯誤。
Cell type 1 is the cortex, type 2 is the cambium, and type 3 is the phloem; they are all living cells, so options A, B, and C are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
木質部導管是由死細胞構成的連續空管，除了提供運輸通道外亦提供機械支持。
Xylem vessels are continuous hollow tubes made of dead cells, providing mechanical support in addition to transport channels.
常見錯誤：忘記木質部導管在成熟時是中空的死細胞，不具備活躍的代謝功能。
Common trap: Forgetting that mature xylem vessels are hollow dead cells lacking active metabolic functions.

[Q5]
📌 參考答案

D. Cell type 1: Storing food; Cell type 4: Transporting water

顯微照片顯示細胞種類1內含有大量澱粉粒，說明其功能為貯存食物。
The photomicrograph shows that cell type 1 contains abundant starch grains, indicating its function is storing food.
細胞種類4是木質部導管，負責將水份由根部輸送到莖和葉部。
Cell type 4 is the xylem vessel, responsible for transporting water from roots to stems and leaves.
皮層並非主要負責光合作用，木質部也不負責運輸食物，因此選項A、B和C不正確。
The cortex is not primarily responsible for photosynthesis, and the xylem does not transport food, so options A, B, and C are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
根部的皮層細胞通常含有澱粉粒作儲備，而木質部專司水份的單向運輸。
The cortex cells in roots typically contain starch grains as reserves, while the xylem specializes in the unidirectional transport of water.
常見錯誤：無法從顯微照片的澱粉粒特徵正確推斷出皮層的貯存功能。
Common trap: Failing to correctly infer the storage function of the cortex from the starch grain features in the photomicrograph.

B. 2

構造2是皮脂腺，其分泌的皮脂能覆蓋皮膚表面，保持毛髮柔軟及防水。

這層脂質可有效防止過多水份從皮膚表面蒸發散失。

皮脂是一種脂質分泌物，能在表皮形成防水層以減少水分散失。
Sebum is a lipid secretion that forms a waterproof layer on the epidermis to reduce water loss.
常見錯誤：將皮脂腺與汗腺的功能混淆，誤以為汗腺能防止水份流失。

[Q7]

A. 1

構造1是表皮，由多層細胞構成，其最內層的馬氏層含有能進行活躍細胞分裂的細胞。
Structure 1 is the epidermis, composed of multiple cell layers, and its innermost Malpighian layer contains active cells capable of rapid cell division.
這些細胞的快速分裂能不斷替換皮膚表面剝落的死細胞。
The rapid division of these cells continuously replaces the dead cells peeling off the skin surface.
構造2、3、4為真皮層內的結構，並非皮膚表層持續更新的活躍細胞來源，故選項B、C及D錯誤。

表皮的最底層（馬氏層）是皮膚細胞活躍增生的地方。
The basal layer of the epidermis (Malpighian layer) is the site of active skin cell proliferation.
常見錯誤：誤以為整層表皮皆為死細胞，忽略了底層活躍分裂的特性。
Common trap: Mistakenly assuming the entire epidermis consists of dead cells, ignoring the actively dividing nature of its basal layer.

[Q8]
📌 參考答案
C. 溶液2內產生糖份。
C. Sugar is produced in solution 2.
📌 詳細解釋
澱粉不溶於水，因此溶液1內的澱粉不會影響溶液的水勢。
Starch is insoluble in water, so the starch in solution 1 does not affect the water potential of the solution.
在溶液2中，澱粉酶把澱粉分解為可溶於水的麥芽糖（糖份），令溶液2的水勢大幅降低。
In solution 2, amylase breaks down starch into water-soluble maltose (sugar), lowering the water potential of solution 2 significantly.
這導致水份進入溶液2的淨速率較溶液1快，使水位升得更高，選項A、B及D並非主因。
This causes the net rate of water entering solution 2 to be faster than that of solution 1, making the water level rise higher, so options A, B, and D are not the main causes.
📌 考試提醒
只有可溶性溶質才能顯著影響及降低溶液的水勢。
Only soluble solutes can significantly affect and lower the water potential of a solution.
常見錯誤：未掌握大分子在滲透作用中對水勢的影響微乎其微。
Common trap: Failing to grasp that large molecules have a negligible effect on water potential in osmosis.

影響實驗結果的物理變數包括儀器的截面積，而生物變數則涵蓋溫度對酵素活性的影響。
Physical variables affecting experimental results include the cross-sectional area of instruments, while biological variables cover temperature effects on enzyme activity.

[Q10]

根據公式，每克糖（碳水化合物）釋放的能量為 1120 J/g，而每克食物X釋放的能量為 2226 J/g。
According to the formula, the energy released per gram of sugar (carbohydrate) is 1120 J/g, while the energy released per gram of food X is 2226 J/g.
食物X每克釋放的能量大約是碳水化合物的兩倍，顯示它含有大量脂質（脂肪和油脂）。
The energy released per gram of food X is roughly twice that of carbohydrates, indicating it contains a large amount of lipids (fats and oils).

脂質的能量值約是碳水化合物或蛋白質的兩倍。
The energy value of lipids is roughly twice that of carbohydrates or proteins.
常見錯誤：未能熟練運用比熱容量公式計算及對比三大營養素的相對能量值。
Common trap: Failing to proficiently use the specific heat capacity formula to calculate and compare the relative energy values of the three major macronutrients.

[Q11]
📌 參考答案
A. 只有(1)和(2)
A. (1) and (2) only

(1)該裝置缺乏隔熱設備，部分熱能會散失至周圍環境，導致水溫上升幅度偏低。
(1) The set-up lacks insulation, allowing some heat energy to be lost to the surroundings, reducing the rise in water temperature.
(2)若食物燃燒不完全，其內部的能量未能完全釋放，這也會構成誤差。
(2) If the food is burnt incompletely, the energy within it is not fully released, which also constitutes an error.
(3)由於能量值是以每單位質量來計算的，所用食物質量的不同不會導致顯著誤差，故答案為A。
(3) Since the energy value is measured per unit mass, the difference in the mass of food used does not cause significant errors, making the answer A.

在簡單的食物量熱法中，最大的誤差來源是熱能流失到空氣或加熱了儀器本身。
In simple food calorimetry, the most significant source of error is heat loss to the air or heating up the apparatus itself.
常見錯誤：學生常誤以為實驗必須使用相同質量的食物，忽略了「每克」計算已標準化了結果。

[Q12]

豬肉、奶和蛋皆為動物性食物，通常含有豐富的脂肪和蛋白質，以及鐵和鈣等礦物鹽。
Pork, milk, and eggs are all animal-sourced foods, usually rich in fats and proteins, as well as mineral salts like iron and calcium.
這些食物並不含有食用纖維，因為食用纖維主要存在於蔬菜等植物的細胞壁中。
These foods do not contain dietary fibre, as dietary fibre is mainly present in the cell walls of plants like vegetables.
因此，食用纖維不存於這些動物性食物中，選項A、B及D不符合題意。
Therefore, dietary fibre is absent in these animal foods, making options A, B, and D incorrect.

食用纖維主要為纖維素，僅存在於植物性食物中，對預防便秘極為重要。
Dietary fibre is mainly cellulose, present only in plant-based foods, and is crucial for preventing constipation.
常見錯誤：誤以為所有營養豐富的食物（如奶和蛋）都一定含有促進腸道蠕動的食用纖維。
Common trap: Mistakenly assuming that all highly nutritious foods (like milk and eggs) must contain dietary fibre that promotes intestinal peristalsis.

真菌依靠細胞外消化進行腐生營養，是生態系統中極為重要的分解者。
Fungi rely on extracellular digestion for saprophytic nutrition and are extremely important decomposers in ecosystems.

[Q14]

在人體內，過多的碳水化合物會轉化為糖原，貯存於肝臟和肌肉中。

當糖原的貯存達到飽和時，剩餘的碳水化合物便會進一步轉化為脂肪作儲存。
When glycogen storage reaches saturation, remaining carbohydrates are further converted into fat for storage.

糖原是動物細胞中碳水化合物的主要貯藏形式，而澱粉則是植物獨有的。
Glycogen is the main storage form of carbohydrates in animal cells, whereas starch is unique to plants.
常見錯誤：忘記人體無法製造或貯存澱粉，錯選包含澱粉的選項。
Common trap: Forgetting that the human body cannot make or store starch, incorrectly choosing options containing starch.

被吸收的脂肪酸和甘油進入上皮細胞後，會重新結合轉化為脂肪。

乳糜管專門負責吸收脂肪微滴和脂溶性維生素，最終匯入淋巴及血液循環。
The lacteal specializes in absorbing fat droplets and fat-soluble vitamins, eventually draining into the lymphatic and blood circulation.

構造2是微血管，負責吸收水溶性營養素，如葡萄糖。

這些微血管內的血液會匯集，利用肝門靜脈運往肝臟進行處理。
The blood in these capillaries converges and is transported to the liver through the hepatic portal vein for processing.
因此，吸收的營養物質首先抵達肝臟而非心、腎或胰臟，選項B、C及D不正確。

肝門靜脈連接小腸和肝臟，確保吸收的營養素在進入全身循環前先經過肝臟的代謝調節。
The hepatic portal vein connects the small intestine and the liver, ensuring absorbed nutrients pass through metabolic regulation in the liver before entering the systemic circulation.
常見錯誤：不熟悉消化後的血液循環路線，誤以為腸道吸收的物質會立刻隨靜脈流回心臟。
Common trap: Lacking familiarity with the post-digestion blood circulation route, mistakenly believing substances absorbed by the intestine immediately flow back to the heart via veins.

鈣與維生素D在營養學上相輔相成，缺乏任何一種都會導致骨骼或牙齒發育不良。
Calcium and vitamin D complement each other nutritionally; a deficiency in either leads to poor bone or tooth development.

C. Open; Open

常見錯誤：學生常誤以為焦點是否落於視網膜前方，而忽略了入射光線角度與發光物體距離之間的物理關聯。

雖然劇烈無氧運動會產生乳酸，但當人體獲得足夠的氧氣後，它會被氧化轉化為葡萄糖和糖原，並不會作為廢物被排出體外。

This allows the body to maintain a massive total oxygen uptake at a lower breathing rate, and it does not increase the physical "concentration" of oxygen in the inhaled air, making options B, C, and D incorrect.

肺活量的大小決定了肺泡容納空氣的物理極限容量，是評估心肺功能的重要指標。
The size of the vital capacity determines the physical limit capacity of the air sacs to hold air, serving as an important indicator for evaluating cardiopulmonary function.
常見錯誤：誤以為較大的肺活量會改變吸入氣體的成分比例（如提高氧氣濃度）。

當人飲用一杯清水後，大量水分被吸收入血，會導致血液的水勢上升（即血液變得較稀）。
When a person drinks a glass of water, a large amount of water is absorbed into the blood, causing the water potential of the blood to increase (i.e., the blood becomes more dilute).
為調節體液滲透壓平衡，腎小管會減少對水分的重吸收，導致有較多未被吸收的水分隨尿液排出體外。
To regulate body fluid osmotic balance, the renal tubules reduce water reabsorption, resulting in a larger amount of unabsorbed water being excreted from the body via urine.
由於排出的尿液體積大幅增加，而排出的鹽分總量並無實質改變，因此尿液中鹽的「濃度」因被稀釋而下降，故選項A、C及D為錯誤的推論。

尿液濃度的改變取決於溶質總量與水分體積的相對比例，多喝水會導致水體積增加而稀釋溶質。
The change in urine concentration depends on the relative ratio of total solute to water volume; drinking more water leads to an increased water volume, which dilutes the solutes.
常見錯誤：混淆了「鹽的排泄總量」與「鹽的濃度」，誤以為濃度下降代表腎臟停止排鹽。

在腎小球進入鮑氏囊的過程中發生的是超過濾作用，這純粹是基於分子體積大小的物理過濾。
What occurs during the passage from the glomerulus into Bowman's capsule is ultrafiltration, which is purely physical filtration based on molecular size.
血液中體積巨大的血漿蛋白質和紅血球無法穿過微血管壁的孔隙，因此過濾液中幾乎不含蛋白質。
Massive plasma proteins and red blood cells in the blood cannot pass through the pores of the capillary walls, so the filtrate contains virtually no protein.
相對地，葡萄糖和尿素等小分子能自由通過，其在濾液中的濃度與血液相同；而由於過濾液缺乏攜氧的紅血球，其氧含量明顯較低，故選項A、B及C不正確。

超過濾作用是一個被動過程，濾液的成分不包含細胞和高分子蛋白質，但包含了所有溶解的小分子營養物和廢物。
Ultrafiltration is a passive process; the composition of the filtrate excludes cells and high-molecular-weight proteins but includes all dissolved small-molecule nutrients and wastes.
常見錯誤：忽略了蛋白質分子的巨大體積，誤以為所有血液溶質都會無差別地進入鮑氏囊。
Common trap: Ignoring the massive size of protein molecules, mistakenly believing all blood solutes enter Bowman's capsule indiscriminately.

The air sacs are the core surfaces for gaseous exchange in the respiratory system, while the coiled tubules of the nephron are the sites responsible for the reabsorption of useful substances in the urinary system.
這兩個構造的表面都纏繞着極為密集的微血管網絡，提供豐富的血液供應，從而維持極大的濃度梯度以加速物質擴散。
The surfaces of both structures are wrapped in extremely dense capillary networks, providing a rich blood supply to maintain a steep concentration gradient to accelerate substance diffusion.
它們的細胞皆沒有纖毛，細胞膜對物質具差異透性（而非全透），且曲小管細胞具有極高的呼吸速率以支持主動運輸，故選項B、C及D描述不正確。

任何需要進行大批量且高效物質交換的人體表面（如肺泡、腸絨毛、腎小管），都必然演化出豐富的微血管網絡以快速運走交換物質。
Any human body surface requiring bulk and highly efficient substance exchange (like air sacs, intestinal villi, renal tubules) inevitably evolves a rich capillary network to rapidly transport away exchanged substances.
常見錯誤：誤以為曲小管僅具備單純的被動擴散功能，忽略了管壁細胞富含粒線體以進行耗能的主動運輸。

當同一種病原體再次入侵時，這些記憶細胞能被迅速激活並大量製造特定的抗體來應對。

Common trap: Incorrectly attributing the "memory" trait of acquired immunity to short-lived antibody molecules, rather than to long-lived memory lymphocytes.
